report.explanation: Traces show gateway /v1/checkout 502 caused by order 502, which stems from payment /v1/authorizations returning 503 in every sampled request; inventory/redis succeed. Metrics confirm ~80% of checkout requests are 502. Root cause is bounded to payment unavailability, but the underlying payment fault is not yet evidenced.
